message: This migration sets transaction = false, but migrations run with migrationsTransactionMode "all". TypeORM throws ForbiddenTransactionModeOverrideError and no pending migration runs.
why: In transaction mode "all", TypeORM wraps every pending migration in one transaction and refuses to start when any of them sets its own transaction property, true or false.
safeAlternative: Set migrationsTransactionMode: "each" in the DataSource and "typeorm": { "transactionMode": "each" } in the orm-preflight config. Or remove the transaction property from the migration.
